units.source_scale_reason: Guides are the accepted paintings at their accepted scale; every video frame keeps one fixed extraction scale and anchor.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed every take by contact strip. Defend and death were retaken with steady light because the first takes darkened or blacked out the plate mid-action. The hit starts at video frame 4 because the first frames hold the reference pose and cut hard into the take. The idle's pulses are wisps moving through the ghost cape, not a light change. Idle, walk, attack and cast are the first takes.
